column3: Server Leaks Version Information via "Server" HTTP Response Header Field
Content Security Policy (CSP) Header Not Set
Current frontend inline styles require style-src 'unsafe-inline'; plugin-level baselining also covers other CSP sub-alerts because alert-reference IDs are rejected by ZAP automation-plan generation

Strict COEP is incompatible with the supported MSAL silent-authentication iframe; the classic baseline scan plugin ID cannot be scoped to COEP alone (per-header alertRef IDs like 90004-2 are rejected by ZAP automation-plan generation), so this also suppresses the COOP and CORP sub-alerts as an accepted residual risk
